node.statement: Conclude bijectivity under exactly the stated extra hypotheses. If S_{P_1,P_2}=S_{P_2,P_1}=0, the domain of alpha in node 1.3.1 reduces to S_{P_1} direct_sum S_{P_2}, so alpha(a_1,a_2)=a_1+a_2 is onto A. If each v_i is bijective onto S_{P_i}, range(V)=S_{P_1}+S_{P_2}=A, hence V is surjective. Node 1.2 gives a positive lower bound for V and therefore injectivity. Thus V is bijective. Without both diagonal bijectivity and both zero-cross-corner assumptions no surjectivity statement is made.
